title: Kausalya reproaches Kaikeyi
introduction: Kausalya reproaches Kaikeyi for her wrong deeds, while weeping profusely for her husband's death. The chamberlains reverently remove Kausalya from the place of the king's body, which they later keep in a trough filled with oil. The ministers and other functionaries return to their abodes, when the night fell in darkness.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे ष्ट्ष्ष्टितम सर्गः
Thus completes 66th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तम् अग्निम् इव संशान्तम् अम्बु हीनम् इव अर्णवम् |
हतप्रभम् इव आदित्यम् स्वर्गथम् प्रेक्ष्य भूमिपम्
कौसल्या बाष्प पूर्ण अक्षी विविधम् शोक कर्शिता |
उपगृह्य शिरः राज्ञः कैकेयीम् प्रत्यभाषत
verses.iast:
tam agnim iva saṃśāntam ambu hīnam iva arṇavam |
hataprabham iva ādityam svargatham prekṣya bhūmipam
kausalyā bāṣpa pūrṇa akṣī vividham śoka karśitā |
upagṛhya śiraḥ rāGYaḥ kaikeyīm pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Seeing the aforesaid deceased king, who looked like a fully extinguished fire, a waterless ocean and a lusterless sun, Kausalya holding the king's head on her lap with her eyes full of tears and who was stricken with grief of various sorts, spoke to Kausalya as follows:

glosses.meaning: having her eyes filled with tears

verses.devanagari:
सकामा भव कैकेयि भुन्क्ष्व राज्यम् अकण्टकम् |
त्यक्त्वा राजानम् एक अग्रा नृशंसे दुष्ट चारिणि
verses.iast:
sakāmā bhava kaikeyi bhunkṣva rājyam akaṇṭakam |
tyaktvā rājānam eka agrā nṛśaṃse duṣṭa cāriṇi
verses.translation: "O Kaikeyi the cruel one and the doer of evils! You be there, having fulfilled your desires. Deserting the king, you can enjoy the kingdom undisturbed and without any hindrance.

glosses.meaning: and the evil doer! Bhava = you be there

verses.devanagari:
विहाय माम् गतः रामः भर्ता च स्वर् गतः मम |
विपथे सार्थ हीना इव न अहम् जीवितुम् उत्सहे
verses.iast:
vihāya mām gataḥ rāmaḥ bhartā ca svar gataḥ mama |
vipathe sārtha hīnā iva na aham jīvitum utsahe
verses.translation: "Rama has left me and gone to the forest. My husband too has left for heaven. I do not wish to live, as one left behind by a caravan in a wrong road."

glosses.meaning: as left behind by a caravan

verses.devanagari:
भर्तारम् तम् परित्यज्य का स्त्री दैवतम् आत्मनः |
इच्चेज् जीवितुम् अन्यत्र कैकेय्याः त्यक्त धर्मणः
verses.iast:
bhartāram tam parityajya kā strī daivatam ātmanaḥ |
iccej jīvitum anyatra kaikeyyāḥ tyakta dharmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Which woman would wish to survive, leaving her husband who was divine, except Kaikeyi who kicked off righteousness?"

verses.devanagari:
न लुब्धो बुध्यते दोषान् किम् पाकम् इव भक्षयन् |
कुब्जा निमित्तम् कैकेय्या राघवाणान् कुलम् हतम्
verses.iast:
na lubdho budhyate doṣān kim pākam iva bhakṣayan |
kubjā nimittam kaikeyyā rāghavāṇān kulam hatam
verses.translation: "A greedy person cannot understand one's faults, like one who eats a forbidden dish. Due to that hump- backed woman, Kaikeyi has ruined the race of Raghu dynasty."

glosses.meaning: one's faults. Bhakshhayanniva = like one who eats

verses.devanagari:
अनियोगे नियुक्तेन राज्ञा रामम् विवासितम् |
सभार्यम् जनकः श्रुत्वा पतितप्स्यति अहम् यथा
verses.iast:
aniyoge niyuktena rāGYā rāmam vivāsitam |
sabhāryam janakaḥ śrutvā patitapsyati aham yathā
verses.translation: "Hearing Rama along with his wife have been sent to exile by the king as he was coerced as he was (Kaikeyi) to do an unworthy act, Janaka will profusely lament as I do."

verses.devanagari:
स मामनाथाम् विधवाम् नाद्य जानाति धार्मिकः |
रामः कमल पत्र अक्षो जीव नाशम् इतः गतः
verses.iast:
sa māmanāthām vidhavām nādya jānāti dhārmikaḥ |
rāmaḥ kamala patra akṣo jīva nāśam itaḥ gataḥ
verses.translation: "Rama the pious man who is possessed of like lotus leaves, and who has disappeared from here even though living, now does not know me to have because a support -less widow.

verses.devanagari:
विदेह राजस्य सुता तहा सीता तपस्विनी |
दुह्खस्य अनुचिता दुह्खम् वने पर्युद्विजिष्यति
verses.iast:
videha rājasya sutā tahā sītā tapasvinī |
duhkhasya anucitā duhkham vane paryudvijiṣyati
verses.translation: "Even so, Sita, the daughter of king of Videha, the pitiable lady and who is unworthy of lamentation, will get frightened with grief in the forest.

verses.devanagari:
नदताम् भीम घोषाणाम् निशासु मृग पक्षिणाम् |
निशम्य नूनम् संस्त्रस्ता राघवम् संश्रयिष्यति
verses.iast:
nadatām bhīma ghoṣāṇām niśāsu mṛga pakṣiṇām |
niśamya nūnam saṃstrastā rāghavam saṃśrayiṣyati
verses.translation: "Greatly alarmed to hear the fearful cries of wild animals and birds making their noises in nights, surely she will cling herself to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
वृद्धः चैव अल्प पुत्रः च वैदेहीम् अनिचिन्तयन् |
सो अपि शोक समाविष्टः ननु त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्
verses.iast:
vṛddhaḥ caiva alpa putraḥ ca vaidehīm anicintayan |
so api śoka samāviṣṭaḥ nanu tyakṣyati jīvitam
verses.translation: "Janaka too who is aged, and who is not having sons, will be thinking of Sita, over whelmed with grief and will surely abandon his life.

glosses.meaning: and who was not having sons

verses.devanagari:
साहमद्यैव दिष्टान्तम् गमिष्यामि पतिव्रता |
इदम् शरीरमालिङ्ग्य प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्
verses.iast:
sāhamadyaiva diṣṭāntam gamiṣyāmi pativratā |
idam śarīramāliṇ^gya pravekśyāmi hutāśanam
verses.translation: "Today itself, I too in devotion to my husband, will meet my appointed end. I shall enter the fire, duly embracing this body of my husband.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् ततः सम्परिष्वज्य विलपन्तीम् तपस्विनीम् |
व्यपनिन्युः सुदुह्ख आर्ताम् कौसल्याम् व्यावहारिकाः
verses.iast:
tām tataḥ sampariṣvajya vilapantīm tapasvinīm |
vyapaninyuḥ suduhkha ārtām kausalyām vyāvahārikāḥ
verses.translation: The chamberlains reverently removed from that place that unfortunate Kausalya, who was in excess of her grief and was closely embracing her dead husband.

glosses.meaning: who was in the excessof her grief
and closely embracing her dead husband.

verses.devanagari:
तैल द्रोण्याम् अथ अमात्याः सम्वेश्य जगती पतिम् |
राज्ञः सर्वाणि अथ आदिष्टाः चक्रुः कर्माणि अनन्तरम्
verses.iast:
taila droṇyām atha amātyāḥ samveśya jagatī patim |
rāGYaḥ sarvāṇi atha ādiṣṭāḥ cakruḥ karmāṇi anantaram
verses.translation: The ministers assigned for the job kept the king in an oil trough and did all the acts that were to be done therafter.

glosses.meaning: that were to be done thereafter

verses.devanagari:
न तु सम्कलनम् राज्ञो विना पुत्रेण मन्त्रिणः |
सर्वज्ञाः कर्तुम् ईषुस् ते ततः रक्षन्ति भूमिपम्
verses.iast:
na tu samkalanam rāGYo vinā putreṇa mantriṇaḥ |
sarvaGYāḥ kartum īṣus te tataḥ rakṣanti bhūmipam
verses.translation: The ministers who were knowing all such matters were not willing to do cremation for the king in the absence of his sons and that is why preserved the king's body .(in an oil through).

glosses.meaning: who were knowing all such matters
in the absence of his sons

verses.devanagari:
तैल द्रोण्याम् तु सचिवैः शायितम् तम् नर अधिपम् |
हा मृतः अयम् इति ज्ञात्वा स्त्रियः ताः पर्यदेवयन्
verses.iast:
taila droṇyām tu sacivaiḥ śāyitam tam nara adhipam |
hā mṛtaḥ ayam iti GYātvā striyaḥ tāḥ paryadevayan
verses.translation: Seeing that the king was laid down in an oil through by the ministers those women in the gynaacium cried "Alas! He is dead!"

verses.devanagari:
बाहून् उद्यम्य कृपणा नेत्र प्रस्रवणैः मुखैः |
रुदन्त्यः शोक सम्तप्ताः कृपणम् पर्यदेवयन्
verses.iast:
bāhūn udyamya kṛpaṇā netra prasravaṇaiḥ mukhaiḥ |
rudantyaḥ śoka samtaptāḥ kṛpaṇam paryadevayan
verses.translation: Crying their faces with eyes flowing with tears, the miserable women through up their arms, stricken with grief as they were and pitiably lamented as follows:

verses.devanagari:
हा महाराज रामेण सततम् प्रियवादिना |
विहीनाः सत्यसन्धेन किमर्थम् विजहासि नः
verses.iast:
hā mahārāja rāmeṇa satatam priyavādinā |
vihīnāḥ satyasandhena kimartham vijahāsi naḥ
verses.translation: "Alas! Great king! When we are already deprived of Rama who speaks lovingly and who always keeps up his promise, why have you left us?"

glosses.meaning: Alas! Great king! ViviinaaH = when we are deprived

verses.devanagari:
कैकेय्या दुष्टभावाया राघवेण वियोजिताः |
कथम् पतिघ्न्या वत्स्यामः समीपे विधवा वयम्
verses.iast:
kaikeyyā duṣṭabhāvāyā rāghaveṇa viyojitāḥ |
katham patighnyā vatsyāmaḥ samīpe vidhavā vayam
verses.translation: "Far in distance from Rama, how shall we without our husband, live in proximity to Kaikeyi of wretched nature, who killed her husband?

verses.devanagari:
स हि नाथः सदास्माकम् तव च प्रभुरात्मवान् |
वनम् रामो गतः श्रीमान् विहाय नृपतिश्रियम्
verses.iast:
sa hi nāthaḥ sadāsmākam tava ca prabhurātmavān |
vanam rāmo gataḥ śrīmān vihāya nṛpatiśriyam
verses.translation: "Rama, a protector to you and all of us as well as a capable, prudent and an eminent man, has indeed gone on exile to the forest, leaving this lovely kingdom.

verses.devanagari:
त्वया तेन च वीरेण विना व्यसनमोहिताः |
कथम् वयम् निवत्स्यामः कैकेय्या च विदूषिताः
verses.iast:
tvayā tena ca vīreṇa vinā vyasanamohitāḥ |
katham vayam nivatsyāmaḥ kaikeyyā ca vidūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: "How can we, being disgraced by Kaikeyi, and stupefied by evil passion, live without you and the heroic Rama."

verses.devanagari:
यया तु राजा रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः |
सीतया सह सम्त्य्क्ताः सा कमन्यम् न हास्यति
verses.iast:
yayā tu rājā rāmaśca lakśmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ |
sītayā saha samtyktāḥ sā kamanyam na hāsyati
verses.translation: "Whom else will Kaikeyi by whom have been abandoned the king as well as Rama along with Lakshmana great strength and Sita- not abandon?

verses.devanagari:
ता बाष्पेण च सम्वीताः शोकेन विपुलेन च |
व्यवेष्टन्त निरानन्दा राघवस्य वरस्त्रीयः
verses.iast:
tā bāṣpeṇa ca samvītāḥ śokena vipulena ca |
vyaveṣṭanta nirānandā rāghavasya varastrīyaḥ
verses.translation: "With tears and excessive agony, those excellent Dasaratha's wives together in a row, rolled on the ground, sorrowful as they were."

verses.devanagari:
निशा नक्षत्र हीना इव स्त्री इव भर्तृ विवर्जिता |
पुरी न अराजत अयोध्या हीना राज्ञा महात्मना
verses.iast:
niśā nakṣatra hīnā iva strī iva bhartṛ vivarjitā |
purī na arājata ayodhyā hīnā rāGYā mahātmanā
verses.translation: The city of Ayodhya, bereft of the high-soled king Dasaratha, was splendour-less, as a night without moon and as awoman without husband.

verses.devanagari:
बाष्प पर्याकुल जना हाहा भूत कुल अन्गना |
शून्य चत्वर वेश्म अन्ता न बभ्राज यथा पुरम्
verses.iast:
bāṣpa paryākula janā hāhā bhūta kula anganā |
śūnya catvara veśma antā na babhrāja yathā puram
verses.translation: With people disturbed with tears, with virtuous women raising cries of distress and with its cross -roads and entrances of houses looking desolate, the city of Ayodhya did not shine as before.

glosses.meaning: with virtuous women raising cries of distress
its cross roads and entrances of horses looking desolate

verses.devanagari:
गत प्रभा द्यौर् इव भास्करम् विना |
व्यपेत नक्षत्र गणा इव शर्वरी |
निवृत्तचारः सहसा गतो रविः |
प्रवृत्तचारा राजनी ह्युपस्थिता
verses.iast:
gata prabhā dyaur iva bhāskaram vinā |
vyapeta nakṣatra gaṇā iva śarvarī |
nivṛttacāraḥ sahasā gato raviḥ |
pravṛttacārā rājanī hyupasthitā
verses.translation: While the king has gone to heaven due to grief and while the king's wives were lying on the ground , the sun suddenly went away retreating its movement. The night approached, with its darkness having proceeded to spread throughout.

glosses.meaning: retreating its movement. rajanii = The night

verses.devanagari:
ऋते तु पुत्राद्दहनम् महीपते |
र्नरोचयन्ते सुहृदः समागताः |
इतीव तस्मिन् शयने न्यवेशय |
न्विचिन्त्य राजानमचिन्त्य दर्शनम्
verses.iast:
ṛte tu putrāddahanam mahīpate |
rnarocayante suhṛdaḥ samāgatāḥ |
itīva tasmin śayane nyaveśaya |
nvicintya rājānamacintya darśanam
verses.translation: The friends and relatives who came there, did not like the king's cremation in the absence of his sons. Thus thinking, they kept the king of inconceivable sight in that resting place(oil- trough)

glosses.meaning: in the absence of his sons

verses.devanagari:
गतप्रभा द्यौरिव भास्करम् विना |
व्यपेतनक्षत्रगणेव शर्वरी |
पुरी बभासे रहिता मह आत्मना |
न च अस्र कण्ठ आकुल मार्ग चत्वरा
verses.iast:
gataprabhā dyauriva bhāskaram vinā |
vyapetanakśatragaṇeva śarvarī |
purī babhāse rahitā maha ātmanā |
na ca asra kaṇṭha ākula mārga catvarā
verses.translation: Deserted by the high-soled Dasaratha, with its roads and cross roads filled with people choked with tears in their throats, the city of Ayodhya, looking like sky without sun and night with its multitude of stars disappeared, did not shine with its light having gone away.

glosses.meaning: with its roads and cross-roads filled with people choked with tears in their throats
with its multitude of stars disappeared
with its light having gone away.

verses.devanagari:
नराः च नार्यः च समेत्य सम्घशो |
विगर्हमाणा भरतस्य मातरम् |
तदा नगर्याम् नर देव सम्क्षये |
बभूवुर् आर्ता न च शर्म लेभिरे
verses.iast:
narāḥ ca nāryaḥ ca sametya samghaśo |
vigarhamāṇā bharatasya mātaram |
tadā nagaryām nara deva samkṣaye |
babhūvur ārtā na ca śarma lebhire
verses.translation: After the king's death, men and women in the city converged in groups, abusing Bharata's mother, became disturbed and did not obtain happiness.
